scope: Step 5: full saved collection, attributed source graph; final POC validation and freeze deferred to Step 6
identity: Source-scoped label snapshots, ingredient occurrences, claims and Reddit records; reuse terminology namespace/native IDs. No canonical merges or same-as edges.
mapping: Export exactly High-confidence terminology, NatMed-subject and additional reviewed category proposals using their approved relation types. Medium, Low and no-target cases remain separate review rows.
dsld: Retain all source assertions, issues, supported transformations and quantity-review gates. Source-declared relationships are attributed annotations, not equivalence. Nested components are not automatically forms.
natmed: Export all technically validated claims as pending annotations with original fields, excerpts, field anchors and citations; never infer product applicability, clinical approval or recommendations.
reddit: Retain posts, comments, passages and source references. Literal mentions and inherited thread topics remain distinct; no efficacy, safety or personal-use inference.
mesh: Preserve typed literals including language/datatype on source subject nodes; preserve URI statements with their predicate and provenance. Uncollected URI targets are references, not fetched entities.
outputs: Separate node-type CSVs, a relationships CSV, provenance JSONL, review queues, immutable input/output hash manifests and validation report.
